hook: Never promise something the clip does not deliver.
Nobody needs your name before they know why the clip matters.
People pay attention to their own frustrations first.
Lead with the problem your viewer already has.
Show the result before the method.
Finish every video with one clear next step.
A clip without a promise is just footage.
Viewers should know what they will learn within the first two seconds.
Ask permission before you publish anyone else's voice or face.
A guest agreed to the full conversation, not necessarily to every clip.
Track one number per post, not ten.
The goal is not to post more.
Claims make people stop scrolling because they create tension.
Keep every short video under sixty seconds, and aim for thirty.
Trim to the first word that matters.
Write the hook before you edit the video.
Reuse the same idea in a different shape.
The first version is usually a description.
Start by listening for claims, not topics.
A hook is a promise made in two seconds.
